messages:
sam_sales: Quick ask  we're running a 48-hour POC for Meridian Health next Wed-Thu. Need a hosted API key for demo traffic (~60k tokens/day). Requirements: short TTL, auditable rotation proof (signed export), emergency revoke by email+API, and mobile demo support. Who can provision and whats the handoff?

mai_se: I can provision. For demos I recommend ttl=48h, minimal scopes (generate:text, embeddings:read). If demo uses phones, dont put the key on-device  use a backend token broker.

mai_se: Example create (use sales svc token):
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys \\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SALES_SVC" \\n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\n  -d '{"name":"meridian-demo","scopes":["generate:text","embeddings:read"],"ttl_hours":48,"notes":"Meridian POC"}' | jq .
```
We return key metadata and the plaintext token once; stash in Vault.

dan_infra: Infra notes: we can enable audit-forwarding to customer SIEM and produce a signed export (JSON + CSV) for any key_id. Default log retention for POCs is 90d; enterprise can request 365d on ticket. Rotation exports include actor, ISO timestamp, and request id.

rachael_sec: Compliance: require ticket justification, 2FA on the sales account that requests the key, TTL <= 7 days, and record the business owner. For signed exports well include a signature header and HMAC.

audit-bot: [automated] key_request_created: id=kr_500500 owner=sam_sales ttl_hours=48 scope=generate:text,embeddings:read status=pending-approval

mai_se: Rotation plan I recommend: create kr_new ~2h before expiry, deploy to demo backend, smoke-test, then revoke kr_old. Never rotate in-place. Revocation command for docs:```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys/kr_500500/revoke \\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $SALES_SVC'
``` Console path: Console  Keys  kr_500500  Revoke. Revoke generates an audit event.

sam_sales: Customers sometimes ask for a CSV proof that rotation happened. Can we export a compact CSV summarizing events (create, rotate, revoke) with actor/email and timestamp?

dan_infra: Yes. Export API: GET /v1/audit/exports?key_id=kr_500500&format=csv&from=2156780000&to=2156866399. We sign the export and attach to the ticket. Example response is a signed S3 URL.

rachael_sec: Add policy note: security will only accept email-initiated emergency revoke if it comes from a verified compliance contact and references the ticket id. Security will verify SSO identity before action. That workflow produces an audit event + signed export if requested.

sam_sales: Weekend demos are tricky. Can we automate rotation with a webhook and an alert to the owner 6h prior?

mai_se: Yes. We can schedule auto-rotation in the Console: Keys  kr_500500  Schedule Rotation -> webhook/email 6h before. Or use token-broker to request on-demand ephemeral tokens. For this POCIll enable scheduled rotation at 36h and webhook notifications to you.

d an_infra: Approving now, enabling audit-forwarding toggle=false by default; set true if they want SIEM. I'll attach a sample signed export and the curl snippets to the sales ticket.

sam_sales: Awesome  please attach the signed CSV export and cc me. Leaving thread open for the ticket link :thumbsup:
